page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual server belonging to the ecs.u2i instance family. It is configured with 2 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified as general purpose. It is suitable for workloads such as lightweight web serving, small-scale application hosting, and development environments that require dedicated CPU resources without massive memory or local storage demands.
